verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for an on-prem AI server with local storage, since such systems can ship secure-erase or sanitization controls, so the axis applies. The pack's only related item is self-encrypting NVMe cache drives. That is an adjacent storage-encryption feature, not a documented retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
